The '''Sds 8/5 dual laser cannon''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. Two Sds 8/5 dual laser cannons were equipped on [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]], a model of [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] prevalently utilized by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="AotCPunchout" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sds 8/5 dual laser cannon was created for the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="EpII">{{Film|II}}</ref> and first appeared in the 2002 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''.<ref name="StarfighterGame">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref> It was first identified in the 2002 punch-out model activity book [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: Ship Schematics Punch-Out Book|''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: Ship Schematics Punch Out Book'']].<ref name="AotCPunchout" />
